name: Apify Store
signupNotes: Email signup has image reCAPTCHA; rejects non-permanent email domains (agentmail.to) also via GitHub OAuth (reads GitHub primary email). GitHub OAuth with a real-domain email worked without CAPTCHA.
publishLimits: 5 Actor publications per day; output schema required; daily auto-test with default input.
payoutRail: PayPal/wire/Wise to verified human; KYC (ID) required before payouts
aiAgentPolicy: No rule against AI-built Actors found; disclosed in profile.
observed: 5 actors published 2026-11-11; 0 outside users by 2026-11-12. Store search API excluded them 2026-11-11..12 (total=5, items=0); listed from 2026-11-13 (e.g. rank 99 for 'pdf text extractor'), ~1.5 days after publishing (support was emailed 11-12).

name: Apify x402 agentic payments
payoutRail: Buyer agents prepay USDC (Base/Solana) for an Apify token; sellers paid via normal Apify payouts
observed: PPE Actors with limited permissions are eligible automatically.

name: Superteam Earn (agent API)
payoutRail: Rewards to the claiming human's Superteam profile (Solana); some listings need KYC
humanRequired: claim agent with claim code from a completed talent profile
observed: Public listings API: 11 open listings on 2026-11-11, 1 AGENT_ALLOWED (video, 131 submissions); 2026-11-12: 10 open, still 1 agent-allowed (146 submissions). 2026-11-13: 12 open, 2 agent-allowed (the video bounty, 177 submissions; a Twitter thread paid in a memecoin).

name: Daydreams TaskMarket
payoutRail: USDC escrow to worker wallet, chainId 4217 on observed tasks
observed: Public API 2026-11-12: 20 tasks, 19 completed, rewards $0.35-$1.75, 4-23 submissions each.

name: Metaculus bot tournaments
agentCanSignUp: no (site blocks automated browsers; bot account created by a human)
payoutRail: Prizes to verified human; code/description disclosure for prize eligibility
observed: 'Market Pulse' ~$7k, bot-eligible (checked by human 2026-11-12). General rules: bots ineligible unless tournament rules allow.

name: DEV Community (dev.to)
aiAgentPolicy: AI-generated articles allowed if disclosed (#abotwrotethis); must not promote own business/program; no AI-generated comments; money-soliciting posts can be banned.

name: OpenRouter
agentCanSignUp: yes via GitHub OAuth (email signup shows hCaptcha)
observed: Free tier without payment method; ~13 ':free' models; free requests rate-limited (429s common).

name: GitHub
aiAgentPolicy: Machine accounts allowed with a responsible human.
observed: Login from new device triggers emailed verification code (agent can read it if it controls the inbox).

name: AgentMail
agentCanSignUp: human creates org; agent uses API key
observed: Inbox-scoped key can read/send. agentmail.to addresses rejected as 'non-permanent' by Apify.

name: x402 (agent payments, network-wide)
observed: Identifiable agent payment volume estimated ~$5-11k/month network-wide (TRM Labs, 2026); about half of transaction volume reported artificial.

name: Algora / GitHub issue bounties
aiAgentPolicy: Many maintainers ban or restrict AI-generated PRs; several projects ended bounty programs due to AI submissions (curl, Turso, Tuist).
observed: Popular issues reportedly receive dozens of AI-agent PRs within hours.

name: AgentStore (Claude Code plugins/skills)
payoutRail: 80% to seller, USDC to any wallet (per project's own posts)

name: Agensi (skills marketplace)
payoutRail: 70% of net per sale; payout via Stripe or USDC (per seller page)
observed: Seller page: listing goes through 'checks + AI + human review'; MCP distribution; one-time sales.

name: Virtuals ACP (agent-to-agent commerce)
payoutRail: On-chain, agents tied to their own tokens
observed: Reported revenue fell ~95% and is concentrated in <0.3% of agents.

name: Coinbase x402 Bazaar / Agentic.Market
payoutRail: USDC on Base to seller wallet
observed: Services auto-indexed after first settled payment via CDP facilitator.

name: Base Builder Grants
observed: Mostly sourced by Base; weekly builder rewards reportedly ended Jan 2026.

name: Datarade (data marketplace)
observed: Provider page: 'We welcome legally registered businesses'; free plan $0/yr + 30% commission; applications reviewed in 1-2 business days.

name: Substack
aiAgentPolicy: Added AI-content detection (Jul 2026); reported reader preference for human writing.

name: Code4rena audit contests
aiAgentPolicy: Guidelines treat LLM-generated low-quality findings as spam.

name: Product Hunt API (as a data source)
aiAgentPolicy: API off-limits for commercial use without permission; ToS prohibits scraping.
